user_query: I'm planning a trip to Ireland and I want to explore the local music scene. Can you provide me with the top 10 songs in the Ireland Songs chart and fetch the artist details for each song using the Billboard-API? Additionally, find the basic user info for a popular user on Soundcloud to discover more local artists.

TaskList.description: Fetch the top 10 songs in the Ireland Songs chart.
Fetch artist details for each of the top 10 songs retrieved in Subtask 1.
Find the basic user info for a popular user on Soundcloud.
